data.narrative:
Farcast is a Series A-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised $23.6M to date. The valuation landscape includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers in the broader sector, though narrow same-stage cohorts remain sparse for precise peer-median benchmarking.

A single applicable valuation method anchors this analysis: stage-progression. Using total capital raised ($23.6M) as a proxy baseline and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier for advancement from Series A to subsequent funding round yields an implied valuation of $47.2M. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied without disclosed revenue; the Space & Aerospace public median P/S of 27.4x across six tickers provides directional context but requires private revenue data to operationalize. Peer-median triangulation was not viable given insufficient same- or adjacent-stage comparable density.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $54M, with a median of $47M. This range reflects a modest confidence interval around stage-progression mechanics in a capital-intensive sector. Key uncertainties include: revenue trajectory and unit economics (undisclosed), timing and probability of next funding round, and whether the sparse private peer set materially constrains method diversity. Public-comp anchoring should be revisited if revenue guidance becomes available. Further validation would benefit from management guidance on burn rate and path to Series B.
